prompt: A vertical amateur photograph on cheap ISO 400 colour film at night, taken from the front end of the single narrow aisle of a British corner shop, looking straight down it to the back. Shelves of tins, crisps and loo roll on both sides, packets unreadable. At the far end a stockroom door stands half open onto pure black. The fluorescent tube nearest the back is dead, so the far end sits in gloom while the near end is lit teal-white. The aisle is empty, yet it feels as if someone has just stepped out of it. Grain, soft focus, slight shake blur, underexposed. Thanks.
